reviews.author: Dakota Abernethy
reviews.text: Very fast with state inspections and very friendly. I called for availability and was told it was first come first serve so I headed there and I was met in the parking lot before I even got out of my vehicle. Definitely going to be a return customer!

reviews.author: Jennifer Ball
reviews.text: Highly recommend this father and son team...very honest and helpful..people you can actually trust!!!

reviews.author: Lisa McKinney
reviews.text: I've been using JR'S Automotive for about 15 years now. I will take my vehicle there to be inspected until he's no longer open. He is always quick and polite. No frills, simple in and out.
